text: {"memo": "Costco Wholesale delivered solid results in FY2024, with total sales of $240.5\u202fbillion, up 5.8% from FY2023. Net income rose to $5.7\u202fbillion, yielding EPS of $5.02, while operating cash flow improved to $7.3\u202fbillion. Gross margin held steady at about 15.5%, supporting an operating margin of roughly 3.6% and a net margin near 2.4%. The comparable\u2011store sales growth remained modest at 3.2%, reflecting continued membership expansion and disciplined expense control. In FY2023, Costco posted $227.5\u202fbillion in revenue, $4.8\u202fbillion in profit and $4.30 EPS, with operating cash flow of $6.5\u202fbillion. The prior year, FY2022, saw $210.9\u202fbillion in sales, $4.5\u202fbillion in net income, $3.90 EPS and $6.0\u202fbillion in operating cash flow. The trend shows consistent double\u2011digit membership growth and a resilient business model that has allowed Costco to maintain healthy cash generation and a strong balance sheet. The stock remains attractively priced relative to its cash\u2011flow generation, offering a solid dividend yield and upside potential as the membership model continues to drive incremental revenue."}
